answer:
The winner of the 2007 Ballon d'Or was **Kaká** (Ricardo Izecson dos Santos Leite). In 2012, he was playing for **Real Madrid**.

He joined Real Madrid from AC Milan in July 2009 and remained with the club until his return to AC Milan in June 2013. During his time at Real Madrid, he won two La Liga titles (including the 2011–12 season) and the UEFA Super Cup (2012).
